attributes.title: Mockup
attributes.lede: A phone you can turn, and an app you can still use.

lesson.concept: A projected screen can remain real DOM
lesson.why: WebGL owns the device mesh while CSS projection places a live interface on its screen. The score cues app actions and chooses the camera, allowing one interface to be examined in 2D and 3D.
lesson.experiment: Switch to 3D before opening an app. Interact with the screen near its corners and compare the hit position with its projected visual position.
lesson.pitfall: A screenshot texture can resemble a screen while losing selection, focus and input. Projection and hit testing must agree.
lesson.combine: Combine with long-take for a readable inner camera and a restrained outer device camera.
